scope.ginger: Bounded scalar nested quantization and score arithmetic; no graph builds, public vector corpus or SIMD throughput run.
scope.gslm2: Discrete tuple and stream-transition evaluation arithmetic; no encoder, speech data, checkpoints, speech generation or benchmark run.
scope.emoreward: Score/gate and completed-run reliability arithmetic; no reward providers, media, image/video models or RL rollouts.

resource_decisions.ginger: Paper §6: 14 datasets, up to one billion vectors; 2.3 TB RAM multi-NUMA machine, not a local Mac or single A100/A30 reproduction.
resource_decisions.gslm2: Paper §3 and appendices: up to 6M speech hours and 6.5B parameters; no encoder or model pretraining within this budget.
resource_decisions.emoreward: Paper §4 and Appendix E: multiple HunyuanVideo 1.5 RL arms, a reference run and video reward providers, plus SD 3.5 and FLUX transfer. No full generator/reward run within the single-device budget; no elapsed-time estimate measured.
